snippet.title: System Shock 2: 25th Anniversary Remaster Official Multiplayer Trailer - FGS Live From Los Angeles
snippet.description:
The official multiplayer trailer for System Shock 2: 25th Anniversary Remaster, which features a look at the absolute chaos of being online with friends in Shodan's sci-fi domain.  This modernized edition of the 1999 classic sci-fi horror action role-playing game by Nightdive Studios is coming to PC and consoles on June 26, 2025.

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS #systemshock2
